no upstream production or power plant ownership."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Reservoir analysis, lab testing and perforating services sold to operators; BKV is a producer and seller of gas and power."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Residential and commercial propane distribution with appliance service; a different product and customer base from BKV's gas production."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Artificial lift equipment rental and field services for operators; BKV sells its own gas and power rather than providing well equipment."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Coal mining and coal-fired power sold to utilities; shares a power plant model but the fuel and mining business differs from BKV's gas."},{"label":"C7","good":true,"reason":"Permian gas gathering, processing and produced water handling for producers, with liquids sales; closely mirrors BKV's gathering and water services."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Compressor rental and fabrication for producers; equipment business rather than gas production, gathering or power sales."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Crude oil refining with retail fuel stations and wholesale fuels; a downstream refining business unlike BKV's upstream gas production."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Frac sand mining and logistics sold to well completion companies; supplies a completion input, not natural gas or power."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Rented mobile turbine power and sand handling equipment under contract; equipment rental model differs from BKV's owned gas production."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Residential propane and heating oil delivery to households through branches; a retail fuel distribution business unlike BKV."},{"label":"C13","good":false,"reason":"Global oilfield drilling and well services with field crews; a service business rather than a gas producer selling gas and power."}]}
